steps.title: Process Stool Samples
steps.instruction: Extract material from stool samples using phosphate buffer saline and ceramic beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.2g stool to 1.0ml phosphate buffer saline (with Mg2+ and Ca2+) in a 1.5ml Eppendorf tube containing 6-8 ceramic beads.
Vortex for 2×20 sec at 4000rpm at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 10 min at 4℃.

steps.title: Process Anal Swabs
steps.instruction: Extract material from anal swabs using phosphate buffer saline.

substeps.instruction: Place the anal swab into 1.0ml phosphate buffer saline (with Mg2+ and Ca2+) and repeatedly squeeze it.
Vortex for 2×20 sec at 4000rpm at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 10 min at 4℃.

steps.title: Process Throat or Environmental Swabs
steps.instruction: Process swabs stored in Hank's solution.

substeps.instruction: Ensure swabs are stored in 3.5ml Hank’s solution (Yocon Catalog #:MT0301-1).
Vortex for 40 sec at 4000rpm at room temperature.

steps.title: Process Food Specimens
steps.instruction: Extract material from food specimen surfaces.

substeps.instruction: Randomly select six points on the surface of the food specimen and cut them into 2mm×2mm×2mm pieces using sterilized scissors.
Add 0.2g of these food pieces to 1.0ml phosphate buffer saline (with Mg2+ and Ca2+) in a 1.5ml Eppendorf tube containing 6-8 ceramic beads.
Vortex for 2×20 sec at 4000rpm at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 10 min at 4℃.

steps.title: Store Remaining Supernatant
steps.instruction: Preserve the remaining supernatant after the RNA/DNA extraction process.
